items.title: The Hilbert-Samuel function in a short exact sequence, and degrees of the associated polynomials
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For a short exact sequence of finite modules over a Noetherian local ring the lemma bounds the discrepancy between the three Hilbert-Samuel functions in degree, identifies the maximum of the degrees of the outer two with the degree of the middle one, and transfers this to the associated dimension function (statement lines 14442-14456). The proof does not estimate each function separately: it chooses a submodule with finite length quotient, uses the degree bound for finite-length differences and additivity to bound the discrepancy, and then reads the degree statements off that bound (proof lines 14458-14486). Choosing the intermediate submodule so that the discrepancy becomes controlled is the content. H2.
